enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Continue sleeping. Turn to other side. Sleep.

Walk to bathroom. Open bathroom door. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto toothbrush. Brush teeth. Spit into sink. Rinse mouth with water. Put down toothbrush. Pick up soap. Lather hands. Wash face. Rinse face. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off light. Open bathroom door. Walk out.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out cereal. Open cabinet. Take out bowl. Take out spoon. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Close milk carton. Put milk back in refrigerator. Close refrigerator. Sit at table. Pick up spoon. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Finish. Pick up bowl and spoon. Walk to sink. Rinse bowl. Place in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Comb hair. Pick up phone. Check phone. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.
Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Clock in. Put on scrubs. Wash hands. Check patient list. Walk to patient room. Take vitals. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Update records. Walk to next patient. Take vitals. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Update records. Walk to break room. Eat lunch. Return to work. Continue patient care. Clock out.
Walk out of workplace. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Place on counter. Open cabinet. Take out pan. Turn on stove. Pour oil into pan. Chop vegetables. Put vegetables in pan. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Add spices. Cook. Turn off stove. Take out plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat. Drink water. Finish. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place in dishwasher.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Browse channels. Select show. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out drink. Walk back. Sit. Drink. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto toothbrush. Brush teeth. Spit into sink. Rinse mouth with water. Put down toothbrush. Pick up soap. Lather hands. Wash face. Rinse face. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off light. Walk out.
Walk to bedroom. Pull back blanket. Lie down. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping.
